title: trigger-api, runtime: the inbound hook door logs a generic cause (unadmitted-address / unknown-flow) for a post refused because its package is disabled, and its comments say undefined covers every unshared name
body:
domain:server#5 · zhuangjianguo · session_01QsR2jUZKdq3PK2Sab53cT3

Follow-up from PR #34278 (#33906), review-c L1 6907084288 nit N1. Filed by area S6. Bug only: text and log cause, no behaviour change.

**What happens.** Since #34278, `AutomationEngine.inboundHookSlot` answers `unadmitted` for a slot whose registry-held package is disabled, and the engine logs the true cause at info (`disabled-holder`). The door's own warn line beside it still names a generic cause (`unadmitted-address` or `unknown-flow`), which is not the reason. The comments at `packages/plugins/trigger-api/src/plugin.ts:20-24` and in `packages/runtime/src/domains/automation-hooks.ts` also say `undefined` covers every unshared name, which is no longer true (a disabled sole holder's name is unshared and refused).

**Ask.** Add a `disabled-holder` member to `UnverifiedPostCause` (trigger-api) and carry it through the runtime door's log text, so the door's warn line names the real cause. Correct both comments. The wire answer stays the one `401 INVALID_SIGNATURE` (cause never sent). Pin: the door log for a disabled holder's post names `disabled-holder`; CONTROL the two existing causes unchanged.

Dedupe words: UnverifiedPostCause disabled holder; inbound hook door log cause disabled package.
